meta.title: Model picker
meta.description: Makes the provider groups in the built-in DeepSeek Harness model menu collapsible. Only the provider holding your current model starts expanded; every other provider folds away while still showing its model count, so opening the menu shows the model you are using instead of a hundred rows. Click any provider heading to expand or fold it; manual state is remembered for the page's lifetime. An active search expands every group so matches are never hidden. Keyboard: Tab to a heading, then Enter or Space to toggle. Install: Plugins → Add plugin → paste github:CamouflageGe/dsh-provider-fold. Known limitation: this is a DOM-level enhancement, so a future DSH release that renames the group markup makes it stop working silently (it never breaks the menu).
